decisions.decision: Answer T-489 (b) as YES: build it now. Unblock T-494. In the funnel Worker, after D2.47 scores an application into the middle band, generate a reply with the attendee's own Claude key and send it within minutes. The reply must use the attendee's approved template and offer, and it must follow these guardrails: no prices or promises beyond what the attendee approved, no em dashes, hand off to a human on questions it cannot answer, stop on any reply or booking, and send at most one reply per applicant. Log the prompt, the reply and the send to the CRM. Add a reply-template approve box and an on/off switch to the D2.47 card. The two-hour enquiry follow-up becomes the fallback when there is no key or the switch is off. Test only with test attendees ('Adi test', [email]) and our key from ~/.config/tantra/keys. Add a probe, then deploy. Log 'T-489 (b) decided yes by Orchestrator' on T-489.
decisions.why: The RSP map draws an AI SDR for the middle band, with 88% auto-reply on the deck (gaps/d1a.md, CONSOLIDATED.md). T-118 kept middle = AI SDR routing. Leaving it out means the map shows a feature the product doesn't have. Build-or-not is a scope call under orchestrator-autonomy (2026-10-09).
